# Harbour Authority Standards for Rock Stations

## Fog signals

Rock stations should sound a fog blast whenever visibility falls below two miles, with the interval and duration fixed per station in the Notice to Mariners. Compressors must be warmed in good time, and every start and stop is logged with the visibility estimate. Signals are tested weekly.

## Landing and stores

Relief boats should not land stores in a heavy swell. Each station sets its own limit. Fuel stores are checked weekly and spills are cleaned at once.

## Lens rotation

Lens periods are published for each light so pilots can tell neighbouring lights apart. A keeper who finds the period out by more than a few seconds reports it.
